program: SkatteFUNN (Skattefradrag for forskning og utvikling i et nyskapende næringsliv), Norges forskningsråd, 2026 call
stopper_list: Not a company in difficulty at approval: company over 3 years with accumulated losses over half of share capital plus share premium cannot be approved; test on last approved accounts or a mellombalanse before approval; capital change counts only if carried out; self-declaration required (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/statstottereglene/vansker/ ; https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/hvem/)

Timing: only applications by 1 Sep are guaranteed processing in the same year; costs before approval count only in the approval calendar year, so approval in 2027 loses 2026 costs (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/sok/ ; https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/vurdering/)
Registered in Brønnøysund with org number and taxable in Norway (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/hvem/)

R&D criteria: challenge without known solution, systematic method, work packages as industrial research or experimental development; routine development excluded (https://www.forskningsradet.no/utlysninger/2026/skattefunn-skattefradrag-for-forskning-og-utvikling-i-et-nyskapende-naringsliv/)

One targeted, bounded project per application with measurable goals, plan and work-package budget (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/sok/ ; https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/vurdering/)

Project manager and organisation representative must verify a Min side profile and accept role invitations (within 7 days) before submission (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/roller/ ; https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/faq/)
Daily timesheets signed at least quarterly, also for hours before approval; absolute requirement (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/godkjenning/prosjektregnskap/)
Personnel cost: 1.2 per mille of salary, max 700 NOK/h, max 1,850 h/person/year; unpaid work excluded (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/godkjenning/prosjektregnskap/)

Auditor must attest and sign project accounts in Altinn even without audit duty (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/godkjenning/prosjektregnskap/ ; https://www.skatteetaten.no/nn/bedrift-og-organisasjon/skatt-for-bedrift-og-organisasjon/skattemelding-for-naringsdrivande/fradrag/forskning-og-gave/skattefunn-ordninga/)
Status or final report to Forskningsrådet by 1 March (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/godkjenning/rapportering/)

Deduction claimed in the skattemelding with næringsspesifikasjon by 31 May (https://www.skatteetaten.no/nn/bedrift-og-organisasjon/skatt-for-bedrift-og-organisasjon/skattemelding-for-naringsdrivande/fradrag/forskning-og-gave/skattefunn-ordninga/)

2026 call: project start between 1 Jan 2026 and 31 Dec 2026; no 2025 costs (https://www.forskningsradet.no/utlysninger/2026/skattefunn-skattefradrag-for-forskning-og-utvikling-i-et-nyskapende-naringsliv/)

Other public aid to the same project: aid-intensity caps can cut the deduction; grants must be sought before the SkatteFUNN project starts (https://www.forskningsradet.no/skattefunn/statstottereglene/Insentiveffekt/)
